business_summary: Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures Limited, an investment holding company, provides logistics services in Belgium, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Singapore, South Korea, Spain, Thailand, Vietnam, and internationally. It operates through Integrated Freight Forwarding Services; Logistics Centre and Related Services; Land Transportation Services; Flexitank Solution and Related Services; and Fourth-Party Logistics (4PL) Services segments. The Integrated Freight Forwarding Services segment offers non-vessel operating common carrier and freight forwarding services. The Logistics Centre and Related Services segment operates two freight villages that focus on multimodal freighting, transit, and value-adding services; and a depot and terminal operator that provide on-dock container depot services. The Land Transportation Services segment that engages in rail, road, and multimodal transportation; and the operation of prime movers, trailers, trucks, cranes, forklifts, reach stackers, and containers. The Flexitank Solution and Related Services segment provides customized flexitank solutions and related services, including advisory, installation, and emergency response services to customers for bulk non-hazardous liquid transportation. The 4PL segment offers business insights; consultative services; and other logistics services such as handling order management, legal compliance, warehousing, and supplier management services. It also engages in the provision of shipping agent, depot, packing, haulage, and crating services; sale of containers; wholesale trade of various goods; manufacture, sale, and distribution of packaging materials for the transport of bulk products; and manufacture of plastic articles for the packing of goods; businesses and services of oil and gas related activities, transshipment services, and related ancillary services. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Klang, Malaysia.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures Limited는 벨기에, 중국, 인도네시아, 말레이시아, 네덜란드, 싱가포르, 한국, 스페인, 태국, 베트남 및 해외에서 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 통합 화물 운송 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 물류센터 및 관련 서비스; 육상운송 서비스; 플렉시탱크 솔루션 및 관련 서비스; 및 4PL(제4자 물류) 서비스 부문. 통합 화물 운송 서비스 부문은 선박이 아닌 일반 운송업체 및 화물 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 물류 센터 및 관련 서비스 부문은 복합 화물 운송, 운송 및 부가가치 서비스에 초점을 맞춘 두 개의 화물 마을을 운영합니다. 및 부두 내 컨테이너 창고 서비스를 제공하는 창고 및 터미널 운영자. 철도, 도로 및 복합 운송에 종사하는 육상 운송 서비스 부문. 원동기, 트레일러, 트럭, 크레인, 지게차, 리치 스태커 및 컨테이너의 작동. 플렉시탱크 솔루션 및 관련 서비스 부문은 자문, 설치 및 비상 대응 서비스를 포함한 맞춤형 플렉시탱크 솔루션 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다.
